title: Cartas: Legends of Ratface
sum: 36 cartas de hq, com o local de cada uma.
body:
- HQ, 36 cartas. Locais segundo a lista da IGN; marque cada uma ao pegar.
- Volte para [[colecao-cartas]].

en.title: Cards: Legends of Ratface
en.body:
- Comic, 36 cards. Locations from IGN's list; tick each one as you grab it.
- Back to [[colecao-cartas]].

On top of the soap dispenser inside the women's bathroom on the coast between the boat launch and Ocean Sound Rd in central Corsair Key
On the step up the back door of the blue and teal house on NW 11th Pl in southwestern La Perle
On the ground underneath a disheveled bookshelf on the side of the kitchen inside a yellow house on the coast, wardened off as a crime scene, on Surfside Dr in southeastern Key Lento

On top of a cabinet on the highest level of a staircase in the back of the abandoned Marbelle Hotel on NW 8th St in southern Crosstown
On the ground in front of a storage locker underneath the bleachers overlooking the bay in the Gloriana Key

On the ground at the top of the observation tower under a bench on the southern beach of the Richard Barebone State Park
